Pineapple Mixed Fruit Smoothie
By: Anncoo
Published: Wednesday, September 1, 2010 - 6:23pm

Ingredients




500 grams Pineapple- cubes
1 Banana- slices
2 Oranges- wedges
300 milliliters Low fat milk
10 Ice cubes

Preparation

1 Place all the ingredients in a blender and process until the ingredients are well blended. 2 Pour into serving cups and squeeze some green lime juice into it and enjoy this refreshing smoothie on a hot day.
